chips.t: Why are there deserts in some countries and rainforests in other countries? It's always very cold at the North Pole and South Pole,even in summer. Why isn’t it very cold all year where you live? Different places have different climates. Climate describes the usual weather of a place over many years and it influences the plants and animals that we find there. There are three main climate zones: polar, temperate and tropical.
chips.zh: 为什么有的国家有沙漠，有的国家有雨林？即使在夏天，北极和南极也总是很冷。为什么你住的地方一年四季都不太冷？不同的地方有不同的气候。气候描述了一个地方多年来的通常天气，它影响着我们在那里发现的植物和动物。主要气候区分为三个：极地、温带和热带。

chips.t: Polar climates are cold all year and there is always snow and ice. In winter the temperatures can be as low as -50℃ and it's dark all the time. In summer there is sun nearly all day, but it's very weak, so it's still cold.

chips.t: Temperate climates usually have winters that aren't very cold and summers that aren’t very hot. Countries in the temperate climate zone have four seasons: winter, spring. summer and autumn.
chips.zh: 温带气候通常冬天不太冷，夏天也不太热。温带气候区国家有四个季节：冬季、春季。夏季和秋季。

chips.t: Tropical climates are hot and humid all year. Countries near the equator are in the tropical climate zone. They don't have four seasons: they only have rainy and dry seasons.

chips.t: In the past, most people who lived in the desert were nomads. Nomads don't have a permanent home. They travel across the desert and they have large tents which keep them cool during the day and warm at night. Traditional clothes use light colours because they're cooler than dark colours . They're also long to protect people's arms and legs from the sun and the sand.
chips.zh: 过去，生活在沙漠中的人们大多是游牧民族。游牧民族没有永久的家。他们穿越沙漠，拥有大帐篷，白天凉爽，晚上温暖。传统服装使用浅色，因为它们比深色更凉爽。它们也很长，可以保护人们的手臂和腿免受阳光和沙子的伤害。

chips.t: Now. there are cities in the deserts because there are more ways of keeping cool. Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates. is a modern, exciting city in the Arabian Desert. There are artificial islands, and also beaches, but when it gets too hot to be outside, people stay at home or go to the air-conditioned shopping centres .

chips.t: Many different cultures have played instruments like the guitar for over 3,000 years. The oldest instrument that we can see today comes from Ancient Egypt. You can see this guitar in a museum in Cairo. It belonged to a singer who sang for the Egyptian queen Hatshepsut.
chips.zh: 3000 多年来，许多不同的文化都演奏吉他等乐器。我们今天看到的最古老的乐器来自古埃及。您可以在开罗的博物馆中看到这把吉他。它属于一位为埃及女王哈特谢普苏特演唱的歌手。

chips.t: This type of guitar had a long neck and only three strings.
chips.zh: 这种吉他的琴颈很长，只有三根弦。

chips.t: T he lute is also an ancient instrument similar to a guitar, but it has a short neck and a body like half a pear. It usually had more strings than a guitar and they were in pairs. From 1100-1500, travelling singers and story tellers played the lute to accompany their songs.
chips.zh: 琵琶也是一种类似吉他的古老乐器，但琴颈短，琴身像半个梨子。它通常比吉他有更多的琴弦，而且它们是成对的。从 1100 年到 1500 年，旅行歌手和说书人都会演奏琵琶来为他们的歌曲伴奏。

chips.t: Guitars sometimes had pairs of strings like the lute, but the guitar changed over time to use single strings. People used guitars with six single strings for the first time in the 1600s in Italy, but the most important change happened in the 1850s. The Spanish guitar maker Antonio Torres Jurado made the guitar's body bigger. His idea made the sound of the guitar louder and better. Most of today's classical guitars follow his design.
chips.zh: 吉他有时像鲁特琴一样有成对的琴弦，但随着时间的推移，吉他变成使用单弦。人们在1600年代的意大利首次使用六根单弦吉他，但最重要的变化发生在1850年代。西班牙吉他制造商Antonio Torres Jurado将吉他的琴体做得更大。他的想法让吉他的声音变得更响亮、更好听。当今大多数古典吉他都遵循他的设计。

chips.t: The first electric guitars appeared in the 1930s. The electric guitar has a solid body and can make many different sounds. We also find them in many different shapes and sizes. Some electric guitars don't look like guitars at all!

chips.zh: 为什么太阳只照射到地球的一部分？

chips.t: As Earth turns in space, the sun shines on only part of the planet. When it's day where you live, it's night time on the other side of the world. This means that when you are eating your breakfast, other children are going to bed. It’s a different time in their country because the world has different time zones.

chips.t: How do the time zones influence us?

A map of the world has lots of lines on it. Lines of latitude go around Earth. They show us the distance from the equator the line that goes round the middle. Lines of longitude go up and down dividing Earth like pieces of an orange.
chips.zh: 世界地图上有很多条线。纬线绕地球一周。它们向我们展示了围绕中间的线距赤道的距离。经线像橙子一样上下划分地球。

chips.t: As soon as Tut was alone, he took them off again. Who were his real enemies? Horemheb and Ay, of course. They were horrible and they never let him do what he wanted. Tut carefully painted Horemheb's and Ay's faces onto the bottom of his new sandals. Then he put them on, he went outside and he jumped up and down in the hot sand!
chips.zh: 当图坦卡蒙独自一人时，他又把它们脱下来。谁是他真正的敌人？当然是霍伦赫布和艾。他们太可怕了，他们从不让他做他想做的事。图坦卡蒙小心地将霍伦赫布和艾伊的脸画在他的新凉鞋的底部。然后他穿上它们，走到外面，在滚烫的沙子里跳来跳去！

chips.t: Later that day, Horemheb and Ay gave Tut a board game. Tut and Ank started to play. Horemheb and Ay stood behind them, watching the game. Suddenly a piece fell off the board. Tut jumped up to get it, but something made him fall over. Did he fall or was he pushed? No-one will ever know, but his leg was broken. It was a very bad break. Tut became sick and died. Ay married Ank and became the next pharaoh.

chips.zh: 一个星期六的早上，门铃响了。布鲁诺打开门，一个男人走了进来。男人深吸了一口气。

chips.t: 'Ah gingerbread! 'he said. 'It smells just like my old granny's kitchen, and I’m sure it tastes delicious, too. Sorry, I'm Mr. Brett, 'he added. 'I have cake shops all over London and I'd like you to bake your special gingerbread for me.
chips.zh: ‘啊姜饼！ ”他说。 “它闻起来就像我老奶奶的厨房，而且我确信它尝起来也很美味。抱歉，我是布雷特先生，”他补充道。 “我在伦敦各地都有蛋糕店，我希望你为我烘焙你特制的姜饼。

chips.t: You could become very rich!' 'Really?' Bruno said, surprised. 'But I just use a traditional recipe. '
chips.zh: 你可能会变得非常富有！ '真的吗？'布鲁诺惊讶地说。 “但我只是使用传统的食谱。 '

chips.t: 'No secret, extra, special ingredient Mr. Brett asked.
chips.zh: “没有秘密，额外的，特殊的成分，布雷特先生问道。

chips.t: 'No. Let me get Dad — you can ask him too, 'Bruno replied.
chips.zh: '不。让我去找爸爸——你也可以问他，”布鲁诺回答道。
布鲁诺感觉如何？为什么？

chips.t: When Bruno went upstairs, Mr. Brett saw a basket of gingerbread people on the hall table. He took one, a gingerbread girl, put it into his pocket and left very quickly.
chips.zh: 当布鲁诺上楼时，布雷特先生看到大厅的桌子上有一篮子姜饼人。他拿了一个姜饼女孩，放进口袋里，很快就离开了。

chips.t: The gingerbread girl was afraid. When Mr. Brett stopped moving, she looked around. She was in a huge bakery.
chips.zh: 姜饼女孩很害怕。当布雷特先生停止移动时，她环顾四周。她在一家大面包店里。

chips.t: 'I have a new biscuit! Crush it up and find out what the secret ingredient is!' she heard Mr. Brett say.
chips.zh: “我有一块新饼干！把它碾碎，找出秘密成分是什么！”她听到布雷特先生说。

chips.t: As soon as Bruno and his dad arrived at Spring Wood, they gave out the gingerbread people. When Bruno came to the last lady, there weren't any left. He couldn't understand it. He always made 50! Checking the basket again, he saw a gingerbread girl lying in the bottom. 'Oh, here she is,' he said. He didn't know anything about the gingerbread girl’s great adventure.
chips.zh: 布鲁诺和他的爸爸一到达斯普林伍德，就分发了姜饼人。当布鲁诺来到最后一位女士面前时，已经没有人了。他无法理解。他总是赚50！他再次查看篮子，发现篮子底部躺着一个姜饼女孩。 “哦，她在这里，”他说。他对姜饼女孩的大冒险一无所知。

chips.t: As he gave the old lady her gingerbread, she smiled and said, 'These biscuits make me so happy. They taste like a bit of home every Saturday! You must put a lot of love into them?
chips.zh: 当他给老太太姜饼时，她微笑着说：“这些饼干让我很高兴。”每个星期六都有家的味道！你一定对他们倾注了很多爱吧？

chips.t: Bruno smiled and said, 'Yes, that's my secret, extra, special ingredient — love.'
chips.zh: 布鲁诺微笑着说：“是的，这就是我的秘密、额外的、特殊的成分——爱。”

chips.t: The old lady knows that Bruno makes his biscuits with love.
